persistentBoundaryReproduction.outputPolicy: New absolute PA_ADMISSION_REPORT outside the candidate checkout is mandatory, existing files are refused, and output is created exclusively with mode 0600. Use a new path per run.
persistentBoundaryReproduction.scope: Only bounded probe-owned private services using the existing authenticated protocol. No global scan, product normal re-execution, physical writer, real/native send or coordinator recovery. The epoch control is construction-time validation, not a runtime epoch/fault matrix. Main keeps its original independently reviewed registered-endpoint logic; do not replace it with the gated wrapper.

acceptedNewScopes: The new source contains an actual callable wrapper over the existing authenticated inspection/cancel transport. It is not merely a descriptor: private actual-product execution reaches and cancels the same live Runner/child when supplied its own registered endpoint and a valid current guard.

A beforeWrite refusal in the actual live-product case leaves the writer active. A trusted current-binding/contract guard permits cancellation and the existing main barrier still requires fresh terminated/closed/complete/quiescent resource proof.

The new harness waits for native_applied and its stop success primarily recognizes runtime.barrier.confirmed. The prior false claim that normal stop never reaches its physical writer is withdrawn correctly.
The normal B-owned producer Q&A and registered-owned physical-stop scope remains; no obsolete B14 failure is used to revoke it.

findings.observation: Construction compares only expected ticket/attempt/epoch and never performs an authenticated inspect. With binding.source different from the actual peer but the same attempt, cancel is sent and the receiver mutates once; response identity checking then throws identity_mismatch. This contradicts the wrapper's pre-write foreign-identity refusal promise.
findings.requiredBoundary: Use the original trusted full producer registration and command identity, obtain and validate the exact peer proof before any side effect, then invoke main's current authorization/operation guard immediately before writing. The beforeWrite callback remains main-owned and must not be a no-op production consumer.
findings.scope: Reproducible new-wrapper boundary failure with private mocks, not evidence that current main exposes a user-facing cancellation permission bypass.

findings.observation: The endpoint type omits the immutable socketIdentity and the implementation lstat-pins whichever socket currently occupies the path. A replacement private socket with the same protocol identity/credential is accepted by this wrapper even when the caller supplies the original registered descriptor with its old inode. The existing connectRunnerRecovery(originalEndpoint) correctly rejects that replacement.
findings.requiredBoundary: Accept the complete exact registered RunnerEndpoint including dev/ino and pass it unchanged to the existing transport. Do not turn filesystem rediscovery into new registration authority. Retain the existing current-binding/full-resource-manifest barrier checks.

findings.observation: ReconnectRefusal declares epoch_not_current, but the implementation returns stale_epoch. Direct strict/exactOptional compilation exits two with TS2322. Root tsconfig excludes apps/runner, so a clean root compile does not establish this module's consumer compatibility.

The /tmp scan is too shallow for actual /tmp/pa-native-r-<id>/<attempt>/runner.sock, and the deeper path uses an incomplete hashed-directory name. It also attempts credentials for unrelated global candidate sockets. The original A immutable registration already holds the exact endpoint, credential reference and inode.
findings.correction: Use loadRecoveryRunner(store, originalAttemptId) for this private instance; no global path scanning, no unrelated credentials, no new registry or root schema change. The narrowed discovery replay passes six cases plus one NOT_TESTED.

findings.observation: The status says sameAttempt was added to the condition, but it is still only success text. The native_applied lookup selects the latest delivery globally rather than the original question target. Stop primarily checks a barrier count without matching its attempt/proof and retains the business-cancel/turn-interrupt fallback that can pass without a barrier. The actual normal instance does match and pass the stronger independent probe; these assertion gaps do not revoke that verified scope.

limits: It reconnects only the existing physical recovery socket; no coordinator process is killed/replaced by the submitted test.
expected is a construction-time caller snapshot, not a current A-state reader. The main guard must re-read principal/contract/current assignment/attempt/epoch and operation authority.

alreadyRecorded is a caller predicate, not proof the Runner actually received a command. Main's real recovery-cancel intent is recorded BEFORE send, so blindly passing store.commands.has would refuse the pending original intent. Preserve intent/result/unknown distinctions and existing idempotent original cancel IDs.

cancel discards the returned authenticated proof and returns sent:true; main must not infer a physical barrier from that boolean. Inspect/consume a fresh complete proof through the existing barrier authority.
No new main product consumer or RFC is delivered; no public index export is added. Only the new native-acceptance harness imports the module directly.

mainCanUseNowWithoutWaitingForB.normalRecipe: Retain tools/bootstrap/probe-wave19-runtime.mjs and the admitted B producer through existing createProductRuntime.native.profile. Normal preparation/Broker Q&A/physical stop need no new normal main API.
mainCanUseNowWithoutWaitingForB.exactRegisteredPhysicalConnection: loadRecoveryRunner(store, originalAttemptId) validates the immutable command receipt/digest/matching registration event and returns body.endpoint with socketIdentity plus body.producer. Existing connectRunnerRecovery(registration.body.endpoint, registration.body.producer) directly performs authenticated inspect/cancel without filesystem discovery or the new wrapper.
mainCanUseNowWithoutWaitingForB.existingGuardedPhysicalConsumer: Main may keep its already-owned reconcileRegisteredRunner/handleRunnerRecovery consumer: it uses original registered identities and stable cancel intent, adopts complete resources through the exact endpoint, then confirmOwnedQuiescence owns final fresh proof/current binding/full manifest commit. Do not replace it with the gated wrapper just to call a new export.
mainCanUseNowWithoutWaitingForB.newWrapperMinimumReviewableRepair: B can repair ReconnectRefusal typing, accept the full existing RunnerEndpoint/RuntimeProducer, perform pre-write exact-peer validation, distinguish durable intent from observed send, and return the VerifiedRunnerInspection. Main can then supply its existing current operation guard and barrier consumer; no second authorization or schema is required for the narrow inspect/cancel use.
mainCanUseNowWithoutWaitingForB.businessRecoveryStillNeedsDelivery: A future actual business stream/session/fact-sink/Broker attachment port is still missing. Main owns authorization restoration and product integration after B publishes the callable service/link implementation and concrete types. Do not treat authenticated inspect or a cancelled writer as resumed business.
